name: Soulless
source:
Desperate to survive, you're thrust into an unfamiliar world. Soulless, you are driven by an insatiable hunger. Now, the hunt begins…

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Soulless]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
为了活命，你不得已闯进了一个陌生的世界。你没有灵魂，只有永远无法满足的饥饿驱使着你。现在，狩猎开始了…
